question: Should this draft Claws update-apply path proceed after fixing partial artifact-provenance persistence, or stay paused until the prerequisite Claws stack settles?
rationale: The PR adds a new mutating CLI and persisted-state behavior on top of open Claws stack work, so maintainers need to choose the acceptable failure semantics and landing order after the concrete bug is fixed.

options.title: Fix Deferred Provenance Then Continue
options.body: Require the update path to avoid any target Claw provenance persistence on partial artifact-installer failure, add regression coverage, and keep the PR in the stack for maintainer review.

options.title: Pause Until The Stack Settles
options.body: Leave the draft open until the prerequisite Claws apply, status/remove, doctor, and dry-run update contracts are accepted.

options.title: Accept Partial Update Provenance
options.body: Maintainers could intentionally allow partial artifact provenance after failed update installs, but that contradicts the PR's stated status/provenance contract and should be documented.

recommendation.title: Fix Deferred Provenance Then Continue
recommendation.body: Require the update path to avoid any target Claw provenance persistence on partial artifact-installer failure, add regression coverage, and keep the PR in the stack for maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a new mutating core CLI/state contract and `CONTRIBUTING.md` identifies `steipete` as the product decision owner.
